description: L2 drawer of canonical Herdr CLI dispatch, role startup, Socket bridge, Layer-0 CI/PR monitoring, and worktree/pane cleanup recipes.

preflight_env.summary: Validate Herdr environment and controller IDs without bare --current.

pane_split.summary: Split controller pane with explicit direction (right for wide, down for narrow/tall) and validate NEW_PANE_ID.

dispatch_helper_writer.summary: One-step fail-closed split, start, trust injection, and file-pointer prompt via herdr-dispatch.sh.
commands: skills/team-lead/scripts/herdr-dispatch.sh --name "merge-tk1a-writer-r1" --kind copilot --cwd "$TASK_WORKTREE" --direction right --prompt "Read briefs/<task>.md; implement only Owned Paths; run verification commands; write the full R10 receipt to <receipt-path> and return <15 lines." --wait --timeout 600000 -- --model gpt-5.6-luna

manual_agent_start_profiles.summary: Explicit profile-based herdr agent start commands (never repeat binary name after --).
manual_agent_start_profiles.writer: herdr agent start "merge-tk1a-writer-r1" --kind copilot --pane "$NEW_PANE_ID" -- --model gpt-5.6-luna --allow-tool write --allow-tool shell --allow-tool url --deny-tool 'shell(rm -rf /:*)' --deny-tool 'shell(herdr server stop:*)' --add-dir ~/Development --add-dir ~/.copilot --add-dir ~/.agents --add-dir ~/.codex --add-dir ~/orca --add-dir /Volumes/SSD --add-dir /tmp --add-dir /private/tmp --add-dir /var/folders --add-dir /private/var/folders --no-ask-user
manual_agent_start_profiles.code_reviewer: herdr agent start "merge-tk1a-reviewer-r1" --kind copilot --pane "$NEW_PANE_ID" -- --model gemini-4-argon --reasoning-effort high --context long_context --allow-tool write --allow-tool url --allow-tool 'shell(git:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(gh:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(python3:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(shasum:*)' --deny-tool 'shell(git commit:*)' --deny-tool 'shell(git push:*)' --deny-tool 'shell(git reset:*)' --add-dir ~/Development --add-dir ~/.copilot --add-dir ~/.agents --add-dir ~/.codex --add-dir ~/orca --add-dir /Volumes/SSD --add-dir /tmp --add-dir /private/tmp --add-dir /var/folders --add-dir /private/var/folders --no-ask-user
manual_agent_start_profiles.pr_monitor: herdr agent start "merge-tk1a-pr-monitor-r1" --kind copilot --pane "$NEW_PANE_ID" -- --model mai-code-2-flash --allow-tool write --allow-tool url --allow-tool 'shell(gh:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(git:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(env:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(python3:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(jq:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(sleep:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(date:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(shasum:*)' --allow-tool 'shell(herdr:*)' --deny-tool 'shell(git commit:*)' --deny-tool 'shell(git push:*)' --deny-tool 'shell(git reset:*)' --add-dir ~/Development --add-dir ~/.copilot --add-dir ~/.agents --add-dir ~/.codex --add-dir ~/orca --add-dir /Volumes/SSD --add-dir /tmp --add-dir /private/tmp --add-dir /var/folders --add-dir /private/var/folders --no-ask-user

file_pointer_prompt.summary: Send file-pointer brief and native goal continuation binding.
file_pointer_prompt.command: herdr agent prompt "$WRITER_NAME" "First call create_goal bound to briefs/<task>.md; read briefs/<task>.md; implement only Owned Paths; write the full R10 receipt to <receipt-path>; then call update_goal(status=\"complete\"|\"blocked\")." --wait --timeout 600000

pr_monitor_fallback.summary: Layer-0 ci-monitor.py is default; use worker.pr_monitor only for failure diagnosis.
pr_monitor_fallback.fallback_dispatch: skills/team-lead/scripts/herdr-dispatch.sh --name "merge-tk1a-pr-monitor-r1" --kind copilot --cwd "$GOAL_HANDOFF" --direction down --prompt "Monitor PR #<num> in <owner/repo> until the PR merges or a required job fails. Poll job conclusions (gh pr checks or actions/runs/<run_id>/jobs). On failure, timed_out, or action_required, fetch that job with gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/actions/jobs/<failed_job_id>/logs. Write R10 receipt to <receipt-path> and return <15 lines with PR_MERGED | PR_CHECKS_GREEN | PR_CHECK_FAILED | PR_CONFLICT." --wait --timeout 600000 -- --model mai-code-2-flash

socket_event_listener_node.summary: Event-driven Herdr UNIX domain socket listener for pane.agent_status_changed.
socket_event_listener_node.script: import net from 'node:net'; const { HERDR_SOCKET_PATH: s, HERDR_PANE_ID: p } = process.env; const sock = net.createConnection(s); sock.on('connect', () => sock.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'events.subscribe', params: { subscriptions: [{ type: 'pane.agent_status_changed', pane_id: p }] } }) + '\n'));
